items.title: Match of the Day
items.description: Highlights of five Premier League matches, including champions Arsenal's trip to Brighton.

items.title: Hits and misses: Spurs hit self-destruct again as Arsenal prove imperfect
'Brave' Brighton put in 'complete' performance to beat Arsenal - Murphy
items.description: Match of the Day pundit Danny Murphy praises Brighton's "incredible" performance in their 3-0 win over Arsenal, predicting they will cause problems for Premier League teams this season.

items.title: Arsenal may move for Endrick in January - Sunday's gossip
items.description: Barcelona may launch a huge offer for Haaland, Arsenal are interested in struggling Endrick, and Liverpool insist on keeping Wirtz

items.title: Gvardiol signals return to best at left-back for Man City
items.description: Josko Gvardiol's season last time out was disrupted by a serious injury but the defender now appears to be returning towards his best by helping Manchester City to an impressive start to the new campaign.

items.title: Carrick has faith in VAR despite derby error
items.description: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick still has faith in VAR despite the derby blunder that cost his side in their home defeat by Manchester City

items.title: A Coventry win 25 years in the making
items.description: Coventry City's win over Nottingham Forest - thanks to Jay Dasilva's goal - was a victory which was over 25 years in the making following some dark days for the Sky Blues.

items.title: Olid's Man Utd take big step forward after 'intense week'
items.description: A week ago, the picture at Manchester United looked bleak. Then on Saturday, victory was snatched away from them at Arsenal. But have we seen signs of improvement from Eva Olid's side?

items.title: Moyes demands more from Everton - but don't mention Europe
items.description: Fifth in the Premier League table and yet to lose this season, Everton are on the up, but boss David Moyes wants further improvements - and don't mention Europe.

items.title: Evans committed to Bristol Rovers amid Hibs links
